name: web-mcp
description: Web research tools for Claude: search (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Brave read in web-mcp's own browser, paper APIs plus Google Scholar and Semantic Scholar, ranked with BM25), fetch (whole pages as markdown), browser (agent-browser) and lookup (passive DNS, RDAP, certificate, Wayback, IP and vulnerability records), all archived in .web/. Needs the web-mcp binary and agent-browser.

binPath.title: web-mcp binary
binPath.description: Path to the web-mcp binary. Default: web-mcp on PATH.

agentBrowserPath.description: Path to the agent-browser binary. Default: agent-browser on PATH.
